source.label: Google Flights four-passenger exact-date audit (Nov 3, 2026)
source.scope: Exact June/July 2027 dates searched November 3, 2026 for three adult fares plus one child fare in economy, as displayed family totals including taxes but excluding optional checked bags and seats. Itinerary lines add $720 transatlantic (or $320 domestic) for bags, $160 per low-cost hop and a $200-$800 seat allowance, rounded up to $100; an end of an existing band moves only when the repriced value differs by more than $300. Results flagged by Google as separate tickets are not treated as protected.
